messages:
kira: FYI saw a confusing case — Console showed config apply success but routing kept old route weights. customer noticed a sudden cost increase.
sam: can you paste the apply_id? we need to know if agents actually picked it up.
kira: apply_id=ap-73655, console returned 200 and link to audit: https://audit.local/ap-73655 but agents report still using v=2026-02-01.
config-bot: apply ap-73655 recorded at 2026-04-02T09:02Z, status=applied_to_controlplane.
otto: we had a similar incident; root cause was partial acceptance — control-plane accepted the write but a subset of edge agents rejected due to operator-lock mismatch. users see success because default behavior is optimistic.
mei: proposal: add an "apply_escrow" token flow. API: client POST /admin/apply returns escrow_token; control-plane will attempt to push config and then POST /admin/apply/{token}/confirm when k-of-n agents ack. Console shows escrow state until confirm or timeout.
sam: nice. also add `mode=quorum` with params `k` and `timeout_ms`. default remains optimistic fast apply. quorum apply should be visible with a small progress indicator and per-agent status.
kira: UX: banner in Console reads: "Apply pending: 2/5 agents ack. Click to see agent rejects." clicking shows reasons like `operator_lock:team-redis` or `version_mismatch`.
otto: implementation detail — agents must return structured reject_reason, not just log. And control-plane should store last-reject per-agent to help debugging.
mei: we should also add a resume API so if quorum fails due to transient issues you can resume without re-editing: `POST /admin/apply/{token}/resume` which retries pending agents. That avoids duplicate applies and preserves a single audit trail.
sam: add an automatic reconcile job: if drift between control-plane desired and agent-reported > 0.1% for 5m, schedule a `quorum` reapply with `k=ceil(n*0.6)` and alert #eng-oncall.
kira: what about secrets? escrow must not leak secret values in logs. store references and mask any secret fields in audit UI.
otto: agreed. also create a short runbook: if escrow times out, check agent versions, operator locks, and run `POST /admin/apply/{token}/force?reason=emergency` which requires SRE approval.
config-bot: runbook created: https://runbooks.local/r/escrow-apply (inserted by config-bot)
mei: next steps: PRs for API + Console banner (sam, 2d), agents: structured rejects + resume hook (otto, 3d), reconcile worker + alerting (kira, 2d). I'll open umbrella ticket INF-2099 and link runbook.
sam: I'll sketch the Console banner and progress UI today. Kira will own rollout.
kira: thanks — this should stop these "silent" partial-rollouts that confuse customers and SRE. :+1:
